_comment: AgentMeasure vendor billing rules — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. Read by the Python CLI (healthcheck/am_healthcheck/vendors.py) and by the browser-local recount (website/recount.js). A parity test in CI fails if the two disagree on the same fixture. Do not edit a consumer; edit this file.

intercom.name: Intercom Fin
intercom.source: fin.ai pricing & outcomes; Intercom help centre (Fin AI Agent outcomes)
notes: confirmed resolution rate and assumed resolution rate are separate published metrics, so a buyer can at least see the split
resolution state is filterable and exposed via API v2.11+

zendesk.name: Zendesk AI Agents
zendesk.source: Zendesk help centre: About the automated resolutions platform; About automated resolution tiers (edited 2026-08-25)
zendesk.no_reversal: deleting a ticket with Resolution type Automated does not undo the consumption of an automated resolution
notes: criteria, thresholds and error rate behind the LLM adjudication are not published
unused allowance does not roll over to the next billing period

hubspot.name: HubSpot Breeze
hubspot.source: secondary; knowledge.hubspot.com is JS-only and could not be read
hubspot.structural_risk: a reopen after the 72-hour lock starts a FRESH billable window instead of deducting the original, which is a double-billing risk rather than a protection

ada.name: Ada
ada.source: ada.cx pricing/terms returned 403; rule reported from public docs
ada.operator_override: operator feedback does not override the automatic classification

salesforce.name: Salesforce Agentforce Help Agent
salesforce.source: press release only; no official metering document is published
notes: no timer, no reopen rule, and no clawback are published
the broader Agentforce product is billed whether or not the issue was resolved

generic.name: Generic per-resolution vendor
generic.source: no vendor rules; only the AgentMeasure standard is applied
